about: GTA 6 record trailers: counters. Trailer 1 got 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 h (Guinness); trailer 2 got 475M+ across all platforms per Rockstar, about 84M on YouTube. Factory Delta #2.

lines.say: G T A 6. Ninety million views. One day.

lines.text: That was the first trailer, and it came out early.
A leak forced Rockstar to post it ahead of schedule.
Just over 90 million views on YouTube, in 24 hours.
Guinness made it official: the most viewed game reveal on YouTube in a day.
Then came trailer two, in May 2025.
Reports say Rockstar claimed 475 million views in 24 hours. Across all platforms.
The biggest video launch of all time, it claims.
But count YouTube alone, and trailer two got about 84 million.
So which record is bigger? Trailer one, or two?
